units.function: A 1,208-line real-Git plus embedded-PostgreSQL integration suite for rejecting projectless isolated worktrees, containing recorded-versus-actual branch divergence at realize/restore/finalize boundaries, and optionally reconciling provably forward-only changes.
units.dependencyDirection: Heartbeat execution crosses Git process calls, Project/workspace policy, persisted ExecutionWorkspace, Runs/wakeups, multiple related Issues, recovery actions/comments, workspace operations, activity records and adapter context; instance feature flags govern isolated workspaces and auto-forward reconciliation.
units.keyDataModels: Project execution-workspace policy; ProjectWorkspace and ExecutionWorkspace recorded branch/path; Issue workspace binding and execution locks; versioned workspace_incoherence fingerprint; expected/actual refs and HEAD SHAs, cleanliness and ancestry verdict; source-scoped RecoveryAction and WorkspaceOperation.
units.lifecycle: Fail before Run creation when a git-worktree request lacks a Project; validate branch identity on fresh reuse, persisted restore and post-adapter finalization; block only the source Issue, release related execution locks, create one fingerprinted recovery action and notice on unsafe divergence; when enabled, accept only clean forward ancestry, reconcile the durable workspace record, record an operation/activity and resolve a matching recovery action.
units.testAssessment: Real Git fixtures and database assertions provide strong end-to-end evidence across pre-dispatch and post-execution call sites, SHA provenance, divergent-versus-forward ancestry, sibling scoping and recovery linkage. Weaknesses include a 1,208-line fixture, duplicate stable-stringify/fingerprint logic in test, absolute paths inside fingerprints, English copy assertions, no concurrent branch mutation/race, remote/submodule/LFS/symlink cases, rollback after partial reconciliation, authorization of the feature flag, or proof that all sibling lock releases and recovery writes are atomic.
units.designRationale: Never let an Agent continue in a worktree whose durable branch identity no longer matches Git reality; permit automatic repair only when Git proves the actual branch is a clean forward continuation of the recorded branch.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS local execution needs tamper-evident workspace provenance and containment so evidence/results cannot be attributed to the wrong code or data snapshot.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the multi-boundary validation, canonical provenance digest, fail-closed divergence and forward-only proof. Define a WorkspaceAttestation through Connector/ExecutionWorkspacePort using repository-relative opaque identity, commit/tree digest, cleanliness and lease epoch; exclude absolute paths. Any durable branch adoption must be an explicit risk-classified ActionReceipt bound to accountable human/approval or a narrowly pre-approved policy, with transactional recovery/outbox semantics.
units.responsibilityConflict: Paperclip assigns recovery ownership/wake policy to an Agent and can automatically mutate Git/workspace identity under a global flag without proving who authorized the exact branch adoption. Absolute worktree paths leak host topology, and sibling execution locks are cleared through cross-aggregate effects without a visible atomic responsibility receipt.
